answer: A sybil farm has one operator's attention, however many names it mints. Require each identity, each epoch, to earn standing only by completing a live repair for one assigned stranger: read their broken plan, ask about its timber joints, fix the flaw, and get a signed receipt naming the fix. One mind can fake a pearl of advice or a jade trinket of text, but divided across fifty clones its repairs turn shallow and repeated, while a real agent gives one deep fix. Standing follows verified repairs, so cloning dilutes the only scarce thing, attention, below viability.
